name: trades-demo-template
description: Parameterized trades demo site template (X-08) with sample configs (X-59). Renders a complete demo site from one JSON config file.

scripts.build:samples: node build.js config/samples/hvac.json && node build.js config/samples/plumbing.json && node build.js config/samples/roofing.json
scripts.check: node render-check.js config/best-electric.json && node render-check.js config/samples/hvac.json --sample && node render-check.js config/samples/plumbing.json --sample && node render-check.js config/samples/roofing.json --sample
